declarations.description:
A board of `c2-kanban-column` columns whose cards people move with a pointer or the keyboard. The board owns the
layout and the interaction only: the cards come from `items` and are drawn by `renderItem` (by default, a title and
a description read from `label-field` and `description-field`). Each column lays out its own header, cards and
footer, and offers `header`, `footer` and `empty` slots.

A move updates `items` (the moved item becomes a copy with its column field set) and fires `card-move`, which an
application listens to in order to save it; calling `preventDefault()` on the event keeps the card where it was.
Moving needs `editable`. With the keyboard, Tab reaches the board's one focusable card and the arrow keys move
between cards; Space picks a card up, the arrow keys, Home and End move it, Space drops it and Escape cancels. Give
the board an accessible name with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.
declarations.name: Kanban

cssProperties.name: --c2-kanban--padding

cssProperties.name: --c2-kanban--scroll-snap-type

members.name: items
members.description: The cards' data, in display order within each column. An array in the property, JSON in the attribute.

members.name: itemKey
members.description: Field holding an item's unique key.

members.name: columnField
members.description: Field holding the `column-id` of an item's column. An item whose column matches no column is not shown.

members.name: labelField
members.description: Field the default renderer shows as the card's title, and the label used in announcements.

members.name: descriptionField
members.description: Field the default renderer shows as a muted second line.

members.name: renderItem
members.description: Renders a card's content, replacing the default title and description.

members.name: editable
members.description: Lets people move cards with a pointer or the keyboard.

members.name: layoutOf
members.description: Items of every column, in display order, keyed by `column-id`.

members.name: placeItem
members.description: `items` with the item taken out and put back into `column` at `index`; a column change copies the item.

members.name: syncColumns
members.description: Hands each column the cards it shows.

members.name: navigationTarget
members.description: Key of the card the arrow, Home and End keys move focus to; `undefined` for any other key.

members.name: updatePointerDestination
members.description: Column under the pointer (the nearest one horizontally), then the slot among its other cards by vertical midpoint.

members.name: startAutoScroll
members.description: Scrolls the board sideways, and the column under the pointer up or down, while the pointer is near an edge.

members.name: wrapperFromEvent
members.description: The card box an event came from, inside one of the columns' shadow roots.

events.name: card-move
events.description: Fired when the user drops a card in a new place, before `items` changes. Cancelable: `preventDefault()` keeps the card where it was. Bubbles and crosses shadow boundaries.

declarations.name: KANBAN_COLUMN_CHANGE_EVENT
declarations.description: Internal protocol event: tells the parent board that a column's id, label or limit changed. Not public API.

One column of a `c2-kanban` board: a header, the column's cards and a footer. The board decides which cards a column
shows and handles moving them; the column only lays them out. The header shows the label and the card count (with
the soft `limit`) unless the `header` slot replaces it.
declarations.name: KanbanColumn

members.name: columnId
members.description: Identifier the column's items carry in their column field, and that `card-move` reports.

members.name: label
members.description: Column name, shown in the default header and used as the accessible name of its card list.

members.name: limit
members.description: Soft work-in-progress limit. Over it the count and the border take the over colour; cards can still be dropped. `0` means none.

members.name: cardCount
members.description: Number of cards the column currently shows, counting the gap of a card being dragged into it.

members.name: overLimit
members.description: Whether the column holds more cards than its `limit`.
